snippet.title: Castle Cat 3 (2004): The Vegas Connection 🏰😺 - Classic Adobe Flash Game
snippet.description:
In the third installment of this four part series, your objective is to safely make your way through the desert so you can reach Las Vegas alive. You will be tested on this trip as aliens, snakes, and bosses are all looking to do you harm. So, avoid enemies by jumping on cacti and earn extra by doing so. Don't forget to use mace and your powerful cannon to blast those baddies away. 

Uploaded to Newgrounds: Mar 9, 2004 at 8:23 AM EST
Links: 
https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/154427
http://castlecat.com/castlecat3.html
http://web.archive.org/web/20190325085047/http://castlecat.com/castlecat3.html
Direct link to .swf: http://web.archive.org/web/20150315214651/https://uploads.ungrounded.net/154000/154427_castle3.swf
Author: Wiesi / Der Spanier
Castle Cat in Las Vegas

The freeware Windows program SWF File Player was used to open the game outside of a browser.
http://www.swffileplayer.com/

Music listing :
Castle Cat 3 - Title (Aqua - Barbie Girl Remix)
Castle Cat 3 - Desert (Westbam - Beatbox Rocker + City of Shamballa Remix)
Castle Cat 3 - Shop (chara - Lemon Candy)
Castle Cat 3 - Las Vegas (Madonna - Music - Shiva Chandra Remix)
Castle Cat 3 - Italia (Ricchi e Poveri - Canzone d'Amore)
Castle Cat 3 - Luxor Sphinx (Beasty Boys - Intergalactic + Chemical Brothers - Under The Influence)
Castle Cat 3 - Bee Level (BERSERK -Forces-)

Thanks to: https://www.youtube.com/c/EvanClue for the music list.   

Website: https://www.nostalgiarealm.com
